[48] The innominate graft was clamped both proximally and distally for 3 minutes and direct suture of the perforation done in two layers (Figure \n).

[54] The aortic dissection recommenced just proximal to the aortic bifurcation and extended into both common iliac arteries with distal extension up to the level of the left common femoral artery.
[55] These chronic changes in the thoracic and abdominal aorta were managed conservatively.
[56] Patient was transferred to a rehabilitative facility, from where she was transferred home.
[57] She has been seen in follow up clinic regularly, last time more than a year following her initial surgery, when she was noted to have made very good progress, maintaining good quality of life.
